name: Chile
oneLineFragment: Torres del Paine granite horns reflected in glacial turquoise lakes.
narrativeStory:
Fierce Patagonian westerlies bending the stunted lenga trees until they grow horizontally. The Cuernos del Paine rise two thousand vertical meters above milky glacial lakes, their dark sedimentary caps contrasting sharply with pale granite towers.

Herds of wild guanaco graze the windswept pampa, watching the shadow of condors glide across the gravel steppe.
subtitle: Patagonian Ice Fields & Torres del Paine
introLines: Winds that flatten the steppe grass in seconds.
Granite horns rising above milky turquoise ice fields.
Nine frames exposed in extreme sub-antarctic conditions.
